title: Data-Driven Design of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Efficient Coalbed Methane Purification: From Molecular Fingerprint Mining to Experimental Validation
authors: Guoqiang Che; Pengtao Guo; Miao Chang; Qingyuan Yang; Dahuan Liu
coreIdea: Data-driven MOF design that links molecular fingerprint mining, reverse design, and experimental validation.
coreIdeaZh: 将分子指纹挖掘、反向设计与实验验证串联起来的数据驱动 MOF 设计路线。
adaptationBoundary: Borrowed workflow-level inspiration only; EcoMOF-AI does not reproduce the CH4/N2 separation model or Ni-BIC result.
adaptationBoundaryZh: 仅借鉴工作流层面的设计思想；EcoMOF-AI 不复现 CH4/N2 分离模型或 Ni-BIC 结果。
evidenceBoundary: Design inspiration and validation-route reference; not evidence for organic-acid catalytic performance.
evidenceBoundaryZh: 作为设计灵感与验证路线参考；不是有机酸催化性能证据。

title: AI-Powered Experimental Discovery of Metal-Organic Frameworks for n/i-Butane Separation
coreIdea: Integrated descriptors and similarity-based training-set optimization reduce screening cost while keeping descriptors experimentally accessible.
coreIdeaZh: 通过 integrated descriptors 与 similarity-based training-set optimization 降低筛选成本，同时保持描述符可由实验/模拟获得。
inspiredModules: Similarity-based sampling / small training subset idea
adaptationBoundary: Target is n/i-butane separation, not organic-acid catalysis. EcoMOF-AI borrows descriptor-system and small-sample validation strategy only.
adaptationBoundaryZh: 该文目标是 n/i-butane 分离，不是有机酸催化；EcoMOF-AI 只借鉴描述符系统与小规模样例验证路线。
evidenceBoundary: Pending bibliographic metadata; do not cite as verified DOI-backed evidence until metadata is checked.
evidenceBoundaryZh: 书目信息待核验；元数据核查前不得作为 DOI-backed 已验证证据引用。

title: The geometric-electronic coupled design of diatomic catalyst towards oxygen reduction reaction
authors: Yan Liu, Yan Yang, Xuanni Lin, Yutao Lin, Zhiwen Zhuo, Dong Liu, Junjie Mao, Jun Jiang
coreIdea: Constructs a catalytic hot spot map using geometric and electronic descriptors to guide diatomic catalyst design.
coreIdeaZh: 使用几何描述符与电子描述符构建催化热区图，以指导双原子催化剂设计。
inspiredModules: Scaffold Map / Dopant Map / Synergy Map
adaptationBoundary: EcoMOF-AI borrows the coupled-descriptor visualization philosophy, not the ORR model, DFT dataset, ML workflow, or experimental claim.
adaptationBoundaryZh: EcoMOF-AI 借鉴耦合描述符可视化思想，而不是复现 ORR 模型、DFT 数据集、ML 工作流或实验结论。
evidenceBoundary: Conceptual visualization inspiration only; EcoMOF-AI hot spot map remains demo/proxy.
evidenceBoundaryZh: 仅作为概念可视化灵感；EcoMOF-AI 热区图仍为 demo/proxy。

title: Modelling and estimation of chemical reaction yields from high-throughput experiments
coreIdea: High-throughput experiment data has a data-generation structure; respecting that structure can prevent misleading black-box ML conclusions.
coreIdeaZh: 高通量实验数据具有特定的数据生成结构；尊重该结构可以避免误导性的黑箱 ML 结论。
adaptationBoundary: The paper addresses HTE yield modelling, not MOF screening. EcoMOF-AI borrows the principle of respecting data structure and avoiding unsupported black-box claims.
adaptationBoundaryZh: 该文讨论 HTE 产率建模，不是 MOF 筛选；EcoMOF-AI 借鉴尊重数据结构、避免无支撑黑箱结论的方法论原则。
evidenceBoundary: Methodology principle only; pending bibliographic metadata.
evidenceBoundaryZh: 仅为方法论原则；书目信息待核验。

title: Machine Learning Reveals In-Cavity Versus Surface Activity for Selective C-H Borylation by Metal-Organic Framework Catalysts
authors: Su et al. (full author list pending)
coreIdea: Interpretable MOF descriptor families help distinguish in-cavity activity from surface or defect-site activity on small experimental datasets.
coreIdeaZh: 可解释 MOF 描述符族用于在小实验数据集上区分腔内活性与表面 / 缺陷位点活性。
inspiredModules: Defect anchoring vs pore confinement mechanism paths
adaptationBoundary: The paper studies Ni-MOF C-H borylation, not CO2-to-organic-acid catalysis. EcoMOF-AI borrows the in-cavity / surface / defect mechanism distinction only.
adaptationBoundaryZh: 该文研究 Ni-MOF C-H borylation，不是 CO2 到有机酸；EcoMOF-AI 只借鉴腔内 / 表面 / 缺陷位点机制区分。
evidenceBoundary: Duplicate upload deduplicated into one record. Pending DOI metadata; not proof of EcoMOF-AI selectivity or ranking.
evidenceBoundaryZh: 重复上传已去重为一条记录。DOI 元数据待核验；不是 EcoMOF-AI 选择性或排名证明。
